client: Luna, I've been feeling really overwhelmed lately because I've been assigned a major group project at university. The thought of having to collaborate with others and then present in front of the class makes my anxiety spike. I can't shake the feeling that I'm going to mess everything up, and honestly, I'm not sure if talking about it in therapy will really help.
therapist: It sounds like you're feeling really overwhelmed and anxious about this group project, especially with the pressure of collaboration and presenting. Your concerns about making mistakes are understandable, and it's okay to feel unsure about whether talking it through will help. It’s important to acknowledge those feelings and explore them together, as they can provide insight into what you’re experiencing right now.
